# ignite-website

> Website for Ignite Algiers 2025. Ticket purchase with payment result pages, visitor magic-link sign-in, barcode scanning for check-in, speaker voting with a live scoreboard, and an admin area. React, TanStack Router, Convex, Vite.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/puIad/ignite-website/blob/main/README.md): stack, scripts and routing
- [VOTING.md](https://github.com/puIad/ignite-website/blob/main/VOTING.md): voting phases

## Source

- [src/routes](https://github.com/puIad/ignite-website/tree/main/src/routes): pages: buy-ticket, scan-barcode, vote, speakers-scoreboard, admin
- [convex](https://github.com/puIad/ignite-website/tree/main/convex): backend: schema, speakers, visitors, voting
